meta.title: Features
meta.description: Unparalleled flexibility and convenience in airline ticket sales: multi-GDS search, every fare type, ancillaries and powerful tools for agencies and sub-agencies.

hero.title: Unparalleled flexibility and convenience in airline ticket sales
hero.text: Empower your agency with a cutting-edge air ticketing system that seamlessly integrates with multiple GDSs and direct airline connections. With access to {{airlines}} airlines across multiple IATA and agency accounts, you get the fastest, most efficient way to secure the best flight options for your customers worldwide.

advanced.title: Advanced features to elevate your business
items: Package price selection for maximum flexibility
Seamless ticket changes, cancellations and refunds

fareTypes.title: Supported fare types
fareTypes.intro: Cater to every passenger category with ease.

ancillaries.title: Value-added services to enhance passenger experience
ancillaries.intro: Offer more than just flights — provide a complete travel experience.

items.text: Effortlessly sell round-trip flights from different airlines in one transaction.
Sub-agencies under your IATA account can manage all ticketing operations from a single platform.
Real-time monitoring of all transactions and activities for complete operational transparency.
Seamless BackOffice integration lets sub-agencies and passengers book tickets with available credit lines.

revenue.title: New-generation solutions for maximum revenue
revenue.text: Leverage AirviaTech's dynamic sales screens to distribute tickets to sub-agencies and corporate customers with tailored pricing models. International travel agencies and airlines can easily provide wholesaler, market-limited, web and corporate-published fares, ensuring global reach and profitability.

closing.title: Stay ahead of the competition
closing.text: AirviaTech is designed to give your agency the edge it needs in a highly competitive travel industry. Unlock new revenue streams, optimize operations and deliver an unmatched booking experience for your customers.
